payload.title: The mutation canary lane has no production caller of build_canary_corpus or register_canary_corpus, so mint_canary_judgments holds no_registered_corpus every night, and the registered gold item would drop sandbox_sha so envelopes would pin the cycle HEAD and name sandbox files that tree does not contain
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:183-188 (build_canary_corpus is defined here and called by nothing outside tests)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:284-317 (register_canary_corpus promotes through the goldset lane and has no caller either)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:320-334 (_gold_item copies verdict, evidence and claim but not the item's sandbox_sha)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:359-367 (with no active corpus the mint returns held no_registered_corpus)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:415 (the mint anchors at the item's sandbox_sha or else the cycle HEAD)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:446-462 (the corpus rebuilt from the active record sets sandbox_sha to None)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:2319-2335 (the outcome_calibration phase only mints and reports held; nothing builds or registers)
payload.rule_violated: WP-J section 4 (operator protocol item 10): the panel is measured continuously against planted bugs; a mechanism with no production caller is dead (the ORPHAN-694 class).
payload.notes: No cycle phase, CLI verb or workflow builds the sandbox corpus or promotes it, so load_active_goldset for the mutation-canary tool is empty, the canary mint is held every night, the role_fitness canary block has nothing to score and the 90 % mutant and false-claim bars are never measured. If a caller is added without further change, the gold item has lost sandbox_sha, so the envelopes pin the cycle HEAD and cite sandbox files absent from that tree and the judges answer on missing files. Close condition: Add the production caller (a phase step that builds the corpus in a hermetic sandbox and registers it) and persist sandbox_sha on the gold item and in _corpus_from_active. Test: on an empty store the phase registers a corpus, and with a measured drain mint_canary_judgments mints envelopes whose target_sha equals each item's sandbox_sha; a source-scan test fails while register_canary_corpus has no non-test caller. Verified at origin/main d716541239.
